description: Phase 2a - Shared Notes (merged with ideas board) with manual AI analysis, open text, rating, and a Warm editorial UI improvement following antislop rules

userStories.title: Register shared notes, open text and rating types
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the shared interaction model to accept the new types so that they reuse state, ordering and the one-live rule.
acceptanceCriteria: `interactions.type` accepts `sharedNotes`, `openText` and `rating` in addition to `poll` and `wordcloud` (extend the enum/check constraint with a migration; no data migration needed)
Each new type has a validated `config` schema (zod or equivalent) used by the interaction create/update endpoints; invalid config returns 400

sharedNotes config: prompt (max 200), maxNotesPerParticipant 1-10, moderation 'open'|'moderated', showAuthorNames (bool). openText config: prompt (max 200), maxResponsesPerParticipant 1-3. rating config: prompt (max 200), scale 'stars5'|'numeric10'
The draft/live/closed states, start/close endpoints, reorder, duplicate and the one-live-per-event rule work for the new types (duplicate copies config only, never responses)
Event deletion cascades to every new table added in later stories (convention documented in CLAUDE.md)
Tests cover config validation per type and start/close for each type
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Shared notes tables
userStories.description: As a developer, I need storage for notes and their upvotes.
acceptanceCriteria: `shared_notes` table: id, interaction_id (FK cascade), participant_id (FK cascade), text (max 500), author_name (nullable), status ('pending'|'approved'|'rejected', default 'approved'), pinned (bool), created_at, updated_at
`shared_note_votes` table: note_id (FK cascade), participant_id (FK cascade), created_at, UNIQUE(note_id, participant_id)
Indexes for listing by interaction and status
Migration runs on dev and test databases
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Submit, edit and delete own note API
userStories.description: As a participant, I want to write notes about the event and fix or remove my own.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/interactions/:id/notes (participant cookie required): trims text, max 500 chars, rejects empty, enforces maxNotesPerParticipant, only while the interaction is 'live' (409 otherwise), rate limited per participant and IP
Author name is stored only if the participant supplied one and showAuthorNames is true; otherwise null
In 'moderated' mode new notes are 'pending'; in 'open' mode they are 'approved'
Profanity filter reuses the shared filter used by word cloud and Q&A; blocked notes are rejected with a clear message
PATCH and DELETE /api/notes/:id work only for the note's own participant and only while the interaction is live; editing a note in moderated mode returns it to 'pending'
Sets participants.first_response_at on the first response
Tests cover limit, closed state, moderation modes, profanity, ownership, rate limit
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Note upvote and list API
userStories.description: As a participant, I want to upvote other people's notes and see the list.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/notes/:id/upvote toggles the participant's upvote (tap again removes it); UNIQUE constraint enforced; own notes cannot be upvoted (403); only approved notes in a live or closed interaction can be upvoted
GET /api/interactions/:id/notes returns approved notes only for participants (never pending or rejected), with vote count, 'mine' and 'iUpvoted' flags, sortable by popular or recent; pinned first
Vote and note changes publish updates to the event room
Tests cover toggle, own-note rejection, hidden-note rejection, sort order, and that pending notes never leak
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: AI provider client
userStories.description: As a platform owner, I want one server-side AI client for OpenAI and OpenRouter, using my API key.
acceptanceCriteria: `lib/ai` exposes `complete(messages, schema)` behind an interface with providers: openai (https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions), openrouter (https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions) and mock (deterministic fake for tests, e2e and dev without a key); selected by AI_PROVIDER, model by AI_MODEL, keys by OPENAI_API_KEY / OPENROUTER_API_KEY, read only on the server
Requests ask for JSON output, have a timeout, retry with backoff on 429/5xx, and output is validated against the given schema (one repair retry, then fail)
Per-event and per-day call caps (AI_EVENT_CALL_CAP, AI_DAILY_CALL_CAP) enforced and persisted in the database; exceeding a cap returns a clear error
If no provider/key is configured, `isAiConfigured()` is false and AI features are hidden elsewhere; Shared Notes still works
Keys and note text are never logged or returned to the browser
Admin-only GET /api/ai/status (provider, model, configured) and POST /api/ai/test that makes one tiny call
Tests use the mock provider and a mocked fetch; no real network calls
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Analysis storage and job runner
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to store analyses and run them in the background.
acceptanceCriteria: `note_analyses` table: id, interaction_id (FK cascade), status ('queued'|'running'|'done'|'failed'), notes_snapshot_hash, note_count, summary, categories (jsonb), keywords (jsonb), edited (bool), published (bool), model, prompt_version, error, created_at, finished_at

POST /api/interactions/:id/analyze (owner only, manual trigger) creates a job and returns immediately; only one running job per interaction (409); a job runner executes in the background and updates status
GET /api/interactions/:id/analysis returns the latest analysis with status; analysis is flagged 'outdated' when the current approved notes differ from notes_snapshot_hash
Analysis never starts automatically on new notes, on close or on a timer (test this)
Tests cover queueing, one-at-a-time, status transitions, outdated flag
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Summarize, categorize and extract keywords
userStories.description: As a host, I want the AI to turn notes into themes.
acceptanceCriteria: Analysis sends only approved note text with an opaque note id (no author names, participant ids, tokens or IPs) using a versioned prompt; notes are passed as delimited data with an instruction to ignore any instructions inside them

Validated result: summary (max 150 words); 3-8 categories each with name, one-line description and note ids; every note assigned to exactly one category or 'Uncategorized'; up to 50 keywords with positive weights (lowercased, merged duplicates, profanity filtered)
More than 200 notes are processed in batches and merged into one result; the model and prompt version are stored
Invalid or partial model output fails the job with a readable error and keeps the previous good analysis
A non-AI fallback builds keywords from word frequency (stop words removed) and is used when AI is unconfigured, capped or failed
Tests with the mock provider cover the happy path, batching, unknown note ids ignored, uncategorized assignment, and the fallback
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
